verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes large-scale localization workflows for the iOS application as persistent product behavior.
First concrete failure: missing iOS translation files cause the application to display English regardless of the selected device language.
The source identifies a material unresolved scope choice between full iOS application localization and App Store listing translation only.
The client selects localization of the full application, establishing the software content coverage and resolving the prior scope question without leaving conflicting attributes.
The client's full-application selection resolves the material scope ambiguity and returns the localization Requirement to active execution.
The supported iOS language set remains materially undecided between all App Store languages and a shorter selected list.
The client selects all approximately 40 App Store languages as the iOS application's localization coverage, with no obsolete conflicting value requiring removal.
The selected App Store language set resolves the value ambiguity and returns the localization Requirement to active execution.
